"""design_4BE0 모델링 준비: 시점(tp)별 코호트·특징·결과 테이블과 분할 배정 생성.
학습/성능 계산은 하지 않는다. 설계서와 data/는 읽기만 한다."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_4BE0.json").read_text())
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

pat = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
labs = labs.merge(adm[["admission_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")


def kdigo_events(cr):
    """cr: 한 입원의 크레아티닌(time, value) 정렬본. 각 측정이 KDIGO를 만족하는지 반환.
    +0.3 mg/dL: 직전 48h 내 최솟값 대비 / 1.5배: 직전 7일 내 최솟값 대비 (같은 입원 내)."""
    t, v = cr["t"].to_numpy(), cr["value"].to_numpy()
    hit = np.zeros(len(v), bool)
    for i in range(len(v)):
        p48 = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))]
        p7d = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))]
        hit[i] = (len(p48) and v[i] - p48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(p7d) and v[i] >= 1.5 * p7d.min())
    return hit


# 시점 생성: admit + offset. (설계서에는 "tp에 아직 재원 중" 조건이 없어 그대로 전부 생성하고 플래그만 단다)
tps = adm.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h * H
tps["in_hospital_at_tp"] = tps.tp < tps.discharge_time
tps["inpatient_hours_in_outcome_window"] = (
    (tps.discharge_time.clip(upper=tps.tp + 48 * H) - tps.tp) / H).clip(lower=0)

cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].copy()
rows = []
for aid, g in cr.groupby("admission_id"):
    g_col = g.sort_values("collect_time").rename(columns={"collect_time": "t"})
    g_col["aki"] = kdigo_events(g_col)
    g_rep = g.sort_values("report_time").rename(columns={"report_time": "t"})
    g_rep["aki"] = kdigo_events(g_rep)
    for tp in tps.loc[tps.admission_id == aid, "tp"]:
        w = g_col[(g_col.t >= tp) & (g_col.t < tp + 48 * H)]
        known = g_rep[(g_rep.t <= tp)]
        # 채취 기준으로는 tp 전에 이미 AKI였으나 tp 시점에 아직 보고되지 않은 경우
        pre_col = g_col[g_col.t < tp]
        rows.append(dict(admission_id=aid, tp=tp,
                         aki_48h=bool(w.aki.any()),
                         n_cr_in_outcome_window=len(w),
                         aki_known_by_tp=bool(known.aki.any()),
                         aki_collected_before_tp=bool(pre_col.aki.any())))
lab_tp = pd.DataFrame(rows)
tps = tps.merge(lab_tp, on=["admission_id", "tp"], how="left")
tps["aki_48h"] = tps.aki_48h.fillna(False).astype(bool)
tps["aki_known_by_tp"] = tps.aki_known_by_tp.fillna(False).astype(bool)
tps["aki_collected_before_tp"] = tps.aki_collected_before_tp.fillna(False).astype(bool)
tps["n_cr_in_outcome_window"] = tps.n_cr_in_outcome_window.fillna(0).astype(int)

# 특징 (설계서 features 순서대로, report_time 기준 창 [start, tp])
def lab_feat(f, base):
    test = f["filter"]["test"]; agg = f["agg"]
    s = f["window"]["start"]
    m = base[["admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]].merge(labs[labs.test.isin(test)], on=["admission_id", "admit_time"])
    lo = m.admit_time if s == "admit" else m.tp - int(s.split("-")[1].rstrip("h")) * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    gb = m.groupby(["admission_id", "tp"]).value
    r = {"min": gb.min, "max": gb.max, "last": gb.last, "count": gb.size}[agg]()
    return r.rename(f["name"])

X = tps.copy()
for f in design["features"]:
    if f["source"] == "labs":
        X = X.merge(lab_feat(f, tps), on=["admission_id", "tp"], how="left")
        if f["agg"] == "count":
            X[f["name"]] = X[f["name"]].fillna(0).astype(int)
X = X.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")

# 코호트: 포함(adult) / 제외(aki_known_by_tp)
X["included"] = (X.age >= 18) & ~X.aki_known_by_tp

feat_names = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "unit", "offset_h", "tp", "admit_time", "discharge_time",
        "discharge_status", "in_hospital_at_tp", "inpatient_hours_in_outcome_window", "n_cr_in_outcome_window",
        "aki_known_by_tp", "aki_collected_before_tp", "included", "aki_48h"]
X = X[cols + [c for c in feat_names if c not in cols]]
X.to_csv(OUT / "timepoints_all.csv.gz", index=False)

# 분할: 설계서 key=family_id. 결측 family_id(단독 환자)는 patient_id로 대체한 그룹을 *잠정* 사용.
sp = design["split"]
grp = pat.assign(split_group=pat.family_id.fillna(pat.patient_id))
groups = np.sort(grp.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * sp["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
grp["split"] = np.where(grp.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")
grp[["patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split"]].to_csv(OUT / "split_assignment_provisional.csv", index=False)
print("done", X.shape)
